title: 第19章 进晨曦学府第20章 中级见闻色霸气
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
翌日清晨，林道从打坐中苏醒，看着外面爽朗的晴天，不由伸了个懒腰。
昨天晚上林道半宿没睡，都在研究山海造化珠，而且他也忍不住，滴了不少鲜血让其恢复一些。
也正如他所预料的那样，随着修复，山海造化珠里，那金色土地又成长不小，增加近一倍，达到方圆四百米。
林道浅尝辄止，他不能把气血真的耗在这里，只有让自己变得更强，才能守护住宝物。
毕竟没有实力，一切都是白搭。
来到洗漱间，清理完自身卫生，来到行李旁，拿出录取通知书，打开手机，看到赵诗涵给他发来不少信息。
林道稍稍回复一下信息，看了下时间，快八点钟了，心里暗自思忖：“昨天没有及时入学，幸好新生入学有三天时间，还是早点去吧！”
林道回想上世，初中不到就辍学了，现在自己有机会了，必须要体验一把。
有人常说没有上过大学，青春都不完整，毕竟每位大学生都拥有，清澈而愚蠢眼神。
林道来到酒店前台，在前台大姐姐灼热眼神中，办理完退房手续，离开时，他手中正拿着前台联系方式。
林道嘴角抽搐，手中用力把纸张捏成粉沫，在风中飘飞，现在的他，心中无女人的境界，休想毁我道心。
一辆出租车驶停在，绿茵葱葱草长莺飞的草地旁，林道从车下来，没办法出租车不能开进去，包括许多私家车。
因为已经有许多豪车停靠在这里，络绎不绝的学生开始步行，这些学生基本上非富即贵。
毕竟是贵族学校，林道虽说没报考就录取了，但有人既然安排好一切，那就既来之则安之。
林道看着眼前，广阔壮观的，绿色草场与花园，也不由心中一震，这晨曦学府花了多少钱啊！
林道收敛心神，开始往晨曦学府走去。
“前面的哥们能不能帮我一下。”一道略显气喘吁吁的男声，从林道背后传来。
林道左右张望了两下，毫不犹豫大步往前走。
王云浩睁大眼睛，看着眼前，毫不理会自己的林道，咬牙切齿道：“哥们我知道你听见了，别装作没听见啊！”
如果不是他东西太多，我王云浩一生从不求人。

林道满脸无奈转身，看着眼前胖子，圆脸小眼睛，身穿昂贵名牌衣服，一看就是富贵人家。
再看身旁三四个行李箱，林道眉毛一挑，淡淡道：“帮你可以，要有代价。”
王云浩小眼睛一转，道：“我请你吃顿饭。”
林道若有深意瞅他一眼，微笑道：“三顿。”
王云浩连忙道：“成交就三顿。”
王云浩内心大笑不止，就三顿饭而已，我王少爷买单。
林道也没有多扯皮，直接拿走最大两个行李，毕竟有免费大餐吃，不寒碜，只希望这胖子到时候不要哭。
王云浩拿起行李箱，连忙跟上道：“哥们！太谢谢你了，我叫王云浩，你呢？”
林道头也没回，淡淡道：“林道。”
林道提着行李箱皱眉问道：“你这行李挺重的，完全可以吩咐你家佣人帮忙。”
王云浩听到此话，表情一愣道：“你不知道吗？在晨曦学府佣人不允许进来，应该说除了学生以外都不能进去。”
林道惊讶道：“封闭式管理。”
这学府够蛮横的。
王云浩郑重道：“还算不上，在这里学生都挺自由的。
之所以是这样，因为晨曦学府的校训：每位学子应以自强、自立、自爱、自尊、自重，正是有这种校训，所以在晨曦学府只能靠自己。”
content_en:
In the early morning of the next day, Lin Dao woke up from meditation, looked at the bright and sunny sky outside, and couldn't help but stretch.
Lin Dao stayed up half the night last night, studying the Mountain and Sea Fortune Bead, and he couldn't help but drip a lot of blood to help it recover.
Just as he expected, with the restoration, the golden land in the Pearl of Mountains and Seas has grown considerably, nearly doubling in size to a radius of four hundred meters.
Lin Dao hesitated. He couldn't really waste his energy and blood here. Only by making himself stronger could he protect the treasure.
After all, without strength, everything is in vain.
He came to the bathroom, cleaned himself up, went to his luggage, took out his admission letter, turned on his phone, and saw a lot of messages from Zhao Shihan.
Lin Dao replied to the message and looked at the time. It was almost eight o'clock. He thought to himself: "I didn't enroll in time yesterday. Fortunately, there are three days for the new students to enroll. It's better to go early!"
Lin Dao recalled that in his last life, he dropped out of junior high school. Now that he has a chance, he must experience it.
Some people often say that youth is incomplete without going to college. After all, every college student has clear and silly eyes.
Lin Dao came to the front desk of the hotel. Under the scorching eyes of the big sister at the front desk, he completed the check-out procedure. When he left, he was holding the front desk contact information in his hand.
The corner of Lin Dao's mouth twitched, and he crushed the paper into powder with his hands, and let it fly in the wind. Now, he has no woman in his heart, so he can't even think of destroying my Taoist heart.
A taxi parked next to a lush green meadow with orioles flying in the air. From the car down the forest road, there was no way the taxi couldn't drive in, including many private cars.
Because there are already many luxury cars parked here, an endless stream of students begin to walk. These students are basically either rich or noble.
After all, it is an aristocratic school. Although Lin Dao was admitted without applying for the exam, since someone has arranged everything, he will take care of himself as soon as he comes.
Lin Dao looked at the vast and spectacular green pastures and gardens in front of him, and couldn't help but feel shocked. How much money did Chenxi Academy spend?
Lin Dao gathered his thoughts and started walking towards Chenxi Academy.
"Brothers in front of you, can you help me?" A slightly panting male voice came from behind Lin Dao.
Lin Dao looked around twice and strode forward without hesitation.
Wang Yunhao opened his eyes wide, looked in front of him, ignored Lin Dao, gritted his teeth and said: "Brother, I know you heard it, don't pretend not to hear it!"
If he didn't have too many things, I, Wang Yunhao, would never ask for help in my life.
Lin Dao turned around with helplessness on his face and looked at the fat man in front of him. He had a round face and small eyes. He was wearing expensive brand-name clothes. He looked like a wealthy man at first glance.
Looking at the three or four suitcases next to him, Lindao raised his eyebrows and said calmly: "I can help you, but there is a price."
Wang Yunhao rolled his eyes and said, "I'll treat you to a meal."
Lin Daoruo glanced at him thoughtfully, smiled and said, "Three meals."
Wang Yunhao said quickly: "It only takes three meals to seal the deal."
Wang Yunhao laughed inwardly, it was just three meals, and I, Master Wang, paid for it.
Lin Dao didn't bother much and just took away the two largest luggages. After all, he had a free meal, which was not shabby. He just hoped that the fat man wouldn't cry when the time came.
Wang Yunhao picked up the suitcase and quickly followed: "Brother! Thank you so much. My name is Wang Yunhao. What's yours?"
Lin Dao didn't look back and said calmly: "Lin Dao."
Lindao frowned as he held the suitcase and asked, "Your luggage is quite heavy. You can definitely ask your servant to help."
When Wang Yunhao heard this, his expression was stunned and he said: "Don't you know? Servants are not allowed to come in at Chenxi Academy. It should be said that no one except students is allowed in."
Lindao said in surprise: "Closed management."
This school is quite arrogant.
Wang Yunhao solemnly said: "Not really, students here are quite free.
The reason for this is because of the school motto of Chenxi Academy: Every student should be self-reliant, self-reliant, and self-loving., self-respect, self-respect, this is the school motto, so you can only rely on yourself at Chenxi Academy. "
